probe_detail.name: Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
Extent of capitalised or shouted typography
A specific concrete detail carries the joke
Sets up an expectation and then turns it

final.name: Segmentation artifact: truncation and container-label prefixes
final.audit_justification: Measures mechanical evidence of truncation or carried-over layout labels from extraction, not the entry's comic content.
final.upstream_parent: record segmentation - how the printed column was split into individual item rows during corpus construction

final.name: Byline metadata residue
final.audit_justification: Measures presence of appended author-name or location metadata, a production artifact rather than joke content.

final.name: Coauthor signature
final.audit_justification: Signals collaborative or joint authorship, a production circumstance that could also plausibly produce genuinely better co-edited entries.

final.name: Reference With Comic Function
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether a reference actively performs comic work (creating tension or reversal) versus being merely decorative, a craft judgment.

final.name: Logical Collapse Depth
final.audit_justification: Assesses whether a statement's apparent sense collapses on a second, specific reading, a comic-structure judgment.

final.name: Vivid Comic Scene
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the wording creates a vivid, specific pictured scene that carries the humor, a craft evaluation.

final.name: Found phrase reframed rather than invented
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether recontextualizing an existing found phrase actually generates the joke's comic work, a craft-technique judgment.

final.name: Joint-byline and recurring-name fingerprint in the credit
final.audit_justification: Reads the credit line for signs of a practised or collaborating submitter, a production/identity fingerprint that could also correlate with genuinely more skilled writing from practice.
final.upstream_parent: the submitter's practice and social organisation in this format (habitual entrants, entrant pairs, entrant circles)

final.name: Cliché Reassignment
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether a familiar phrase is relocated so its usual implication becomes newly comic, a craft judgment.

final.name: Formal-structure discipline (meter/rhyme/reversal precision)
final.audit_justification: Scores technical precision of meter, rhyme, or structural execution within a named literary form, a craft-skill judgment.

final.name: Contest-Aware Metahumor
final.audit_justification: Requires the metahumor to remain a functioning joke rather than merely be present, so it judges execution, not just topic.

final.name: Morphological wordplay
final.audit_justification: Measures raw extent of spelling/word-substitution habits while explicitly excluding judgment of effectiveness, though a wordplay-prone habit could also underlie genuinely layered puns.

final.name: Readable Contradiction
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a contradiction is precise and instantly legible versus merely arbitrary or paradoxical, a comic-craft evaluation.

final.name: Interrogative/question-form surface syntax
final.audit_justification: Scores only surface question-form syntax (opening word, terminal punctuation), explicitly excluding judgment of the question's cleverness.
final.upstream_parent: surface-only (a template feature largely forced by the 'Jeopardy!' prompt's own answer-to-question genre requirement, not an independent authorial quality choice)

final.name: Mutual Semantic Lock
final.audit_justification: Evaluates whether the entry's parts make one another newly meaningful, a structural craft judgment.

final.name: Crude/taboo content as sole comedic engine
final.audit_justification: Classifies reliance on taboo or crude subject matter as the comedic engine, a subject-matter marker rather than a direct craft assessment.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction does not score the presence of taboo subject matter; its operative clause asks whether that material is carrying the joke essentially alone 'with little additional wit layered on top', which forces the judge to assess wit density and construction rather than topic. A high score therefore is direct (inverse) evidence about comedic craft -- a one-trick shock pun -- and not merely a subject-matter fingerprint that travels with quality.

final.name: Multi-layered simultaneous wordplay
final.audit_justification: Counts how many independent semantic layers the central wordplay activates simultaneously, a craft-complexity judgment.

final.name: Raw length, clause count and syntactic elaboration
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a raw size/verbosity measurement that forbids judging whether the length is appropriate, padded, or a virtue.

final.name: Self-demonstrating execution (the entry enacts its own claim)
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry's form enacts its own content, a form/content collision that is a craft evaluation.

final.name: Dated cultural anchoring
final.audit_justification: Measures dependence on period-bound people, tech, or institutions, a temporal-tell/topic marker explicitly not judged for quality.

final.name: Proper-name density
final.audit_justification: Counts named entities without judging their appropriateness, a density statistic, though a habitual preference for naming specifics could also underlie genuinely quality-relevant concrete detail.

final.name: In-group reference to the column and its rituals
final.audit_justification: Measures presence of references to the column's own rituals and community, a venue-insider marker, though it could also reflect a veteran entrant's genuinely sharper insider craft.
final.upstream_parent: the submitter's embeddedness in the column's readership community (how long and how closely they have followed it)

final.name: Perspective Reversal
final.audit_justification: Judges whether a viewpoint shift makes a familiar institution or activity absurd, a comic-technique evaluation.

final.name: Economy: comedic payoff per word
final.audit_justification: Evaluates the ratio of comic payoff delivered to text length, a craft-economy judgment.

final.name: Topical/biographical knowledge required to resolve joke
final.audit_justification: Measures dependence on outside topical or biographical knowledge for the joke to resolve, a self-containedness/topic marker, not a craft judgment.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction measures self-containedness -- whether the payoff needs an external scandal or biographical fact -- which a brilliantly executed allusive entry and an inert one would both score at the ceiling, so the score is about the entry's topical mode, not its quality. It is marked mixed because the upstream cause (building a joke on a well-chosen real-world referent) plausibly co-occurs with genuine inventiveness, so the discount could suppress real craft signal.
